name: @bugboom/mcp

tools.name: get_settings
tools.description: The test settings of the organization the API key belongs to (home URL, browser — incl. mediaPermissions and closeWindowOnSuccess —, timeouts with the default sleepMs, waiting conditions, selectors with mode and methods, screenshots, capture: domSnapshotOnFailure / consoleLogs / networkLogs, visualRegression: maxDiffPercent / pixelThreshold / includeAntiAliasing, cloudLocation — the country cloud runs start from, de…) with the counts of tests, components and variables, the test folders (for create_test) and the run profiles (for run_test).

tools.name: list_tests
tools.description: The tests of the organization: id, name, externalId (its id in another system), folder, labels. Use get_test for the groups and steps of one.

name.description: Only items whose name contains this text (any case)

labelIds.description: Only the tests with any of these labels (list_labels)

externalId.description: Only the tests with exactly this id of another system

tools.name: list_labels
tools.description: The labels of the organization by name: id, name, color, testsCount. Put them on a test with labelIds of create_test / update_test; list_tests with labelIds finds the tests with any of them.

tools.name: list_test_folders
tools.description: The test folders, flat: parents before their children (parentId), siblings by position; itemsCount = the tests right in a folder. Put a test in one with folderId of create_test / update_test.

tools.name: get_test
tools.description: A test with its groups (components marked isComponent) and their steps: type, params, selectors, waiting conditions, ifCondition branches. Pass testId, or the exact name. Defaults are left out; raw: true gives the API answer as it is.

name.description: The exact test name, instead of testId

raw.description: The full API answer (selector ids and scores, timestamps…)

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: Components (groups of steps shared by tests): id, name, steps count, tests using them. Insert one with insert_component.

tools.name: list_suites
tools.description: Suites (sets of tests run together): id, name. Run one with run_suite.

name.description: Only items whose name contains this text (any case)

tools.name: list_variables
tools.description: The saved variables, used in steps as {{key}}. Secret ones come without their value.

tools.name: create_variable
tools.description: Add a saved variable, then use it in steps as {{key}}.

type.description: `value` (default): a literal; `evaluate`: JavaScript run at the start of each run

value.description: The literal, or the JavaScript of an `evaluate` variable

isSecret.description: Stored encrypted, masked in runs, never returned

tools.name: update_variable
tools.description: Change a saved variable; fields left out stay as they are.

type.description: `value` (default): a literal; `evaluate`: JavaScript run at the start of each run

value.description: The literal, or the JavaScript of an `evaluate` variable

isSecret.description: Stored encrypted, masked in runs, never returned

tools.name: create_test
tools.description: Create an empty test; then add_group / insert_component and create_steps.

externalId.description: The test's id in another system, e.g. the tool it is moved from

tools.name: update_test
tools.description: Rename a test, move it to a folder, change its notes, external id, labels, screen size or timeout; fields left out stay as they are.

externalId.description: The test's id in another system (null clears it)

labelIds.description: Replaces the labels of the test ([] takes them all off; list_labels)

tools.name: delete_test
tools.description: Delete a test with its own groups (components stay for the other tests). Cannot be undone.

tools.name: create_test_folder
tools.description: Create a test folder at the end of its parent (the top level without parentId); put tests in it with folderId.

tools.name: update_test_folder
tools.description: Rename a test folder, move it into another one (parentId; null: the top level) or reorder it among its siblings (position from 0); fields left out stay as they are. Its tests and subfolders go with it.

position.description: Index among the siblings from 0 (default on a move: the end)

annotations.title: Rename or move a test folder

tools.name: delete_test_folder
tools.description: Delete a test folder. No test is deleted: its tests and subfolders move up to its parent (the top level).

tools.name: create_label
tools.description: Create a label of the tests (gray without color); put it on tests with labelIds of create_test / update_test.

name.description: Unique in the organization, whatever its case

tools.name: update_label
tools.description: Rename a label or change its color; fields left out stay as they are. The tests keep it.

tools.name: delete_label
tools.description: Delete a label. No test is deleted: the label is taken off every test that carries it.

tools.name: add_group
tools.description: Add a new empty group of steps to a test; fill it with create_steps (its groupId is in the answer).

tools.name: insert_component
tools.description: Use a component (list_components) in a test: its steps run there and stay shared with the other tests.

tools.name: update_test_group
tools.description: Move a group within a test (position from 0) or switch it off / on in that test (isActive). testGroupId is in get_test.

testGroupId.description: The group in this test (testGroupId of get_test) (UUID)

annotations.title: Move or switch off a group

tools.name: remove_group
tools.description: Remove a group from a test: its own steps are deleted; a component only leaves this test.

testGroupId.description: The group in this test (testGroupId of get_test) (UUID)

tools.name: convert_group_to_component
tools.description: Make a group of a test a component, so other tests can insert it (insert_component).

annotations.title: Convert a group to a component

tools.name: create_steps
tools.description: Add steps to a group, in order, at atIndex (default: the end) — or into the then / else branch of an ifCondition (blockId + branch). Each step: type, params (read bugboom://docs/steps/{type}), and for element steps a selector. Steps are created as made by an agent.

name.description: A readable name (null: show the type)

params.description: The fields of the step type (resource bugboom://docs/steps/{type}). On update it replaces the whole object: send every field

selector.description: The element: one CSS selector or XPath (`//…`, `(…)[2]`; prefix `css=` / `xpath=` to force). Replaces the selectors presets

waitingConditions.description: The step's overrides of the waiting conditions of the test settings

continueOnFailure.description: Report a failure but carry on with the next steps

runTimeoutMs.description: The step's timeout (null: the one of the test settings)

externalId.description: The step's id in another system (null clears it)

frame.description: {tabNo?, frameSelectorsPresets?}: the tab / iframe the step acts in

blockId.description: An ifCondition step of the group (UUID)

tools.name: update_step
tools.description: Change a step: its params (the whole object: read the current ones with get_test), selector, waiting conditions, timeout, continueOnFailure… Fields left out stay as they are.

name.description: A readable name (null: show the type)

params.description: The fields of the step type (resource bugboom://docs/steps/{type}). On update it replaces the whole object: send every field

selector.description: The element: one CSS selector or XPath (`//…`, `(…)[2]`; prefix `css=` / `xpath=` to force). Replaces the selectors presets

waitingConditions.description: The step's overrides of the waiting conditions of the test settings

continueOnFailure.description: Report a failure but carry on with the next steps

runTimeoutMs.description: The step's timeout (null: the one of the test settings)

externalId.description: The step's id in another system (null clears it)

frame.description: {tabNo?, frameSelectorsPresets?}: the tab / iframe the step acts in

tools.name: move_step
tools.description: Move a step within its group or to another group (an ifCondition moves with its branches).

blockId.description: An ifCondition step of the target group (UUID)

tools.name: delete_step
tools.description: Delete a step (an ifCondition with its branches). Cannot be undone.

tools.name: run_test
tools.description: Start a cloud run of a test; returns at once with the runId. Then wait_for_run.

profile.description: Run profile: name or id (get_settings lists them; default: the profile marked as default)

variables.description: Variables for this run only, {key: value}; they win over the profile and the saved variables

tools.name: run_suite
tools.description: Start a cloud run of a suite (all its tests); returns at once with the runId. Then wait_for_run with kind "suite".

profile.description: Run profile: name or id (get_settings lists them; default: the profile marked as default)

variables.description: Variables for this run only, {key: value}; they win over the profile and the saved variables

tools.name: get_run
tools.description: The state of a run now: status (queued, running, passed, passed-with-issues, failed, error, stopped), duration, error code, and its steps (test run, each with stepRunId) or test runs (suite run).

kind.description: test (default when unsure: test, then suite) or suite

tools.name: wait_for_run
tools.description: Wait until a run finishes (sending progress notifications) and return it like get_run. After timeoutSeconds (default 300; a hosted server stops sooner) it returns the run still going, with timedOut: true: call it again.

kind.description: test (default when unsure: test, then suite) or suite

tools.name: stop_run
tools.description: Ask a run to stop; it ends "stopped" in a few seconds. A run that already finished is returned as it is.

kind.description: test (default when unsure: test, then suite) or suite

tools.name: get_failed_step
tools.description: What went wrong in a step of a test run (default: the step it failed at): the error code and message, computed values (expected / actual, the selector used, the URL; the request, response and checks of a `request` step), the waiting conditions as the runner saw them, visual regression numbers, and whether a DOM snapshot and a screenshot are there. stepId is the step to fix with update_step.

stepRunId.description: Step run id (stepRunId in get_run / wait_for_run; default: the failed step) (UUID)

tools.name: query_dom_snapshot
tools.description: The page of a failed step as it was (scripts and secrets removed). With query (a CSS selector, or an XPath starting with / or ( ): up to 20 matching elements with their XPath and HTML, and the total count — use it to check or find a selector. Without query: the HTML itself, cut at maxChars.

stepRunId.description: Step run id (stepRunId in get_run / wait_for_run; default: the failed step) (UUID)

query.description: CSS selector or XPath, e.g. "title", "#email", "//button[normalize-space()='Sign in']"

maxChars.description: Without query: how much HTML to return (default 20000)

tools.name: get_step_screenshot
tools.description: The screenshot taken after a step of a test run (default: the failed step), as an image.

stepRunId.description: Step run id (stepRunId in get_run / wait_for_run; default: the failed step) (UUID)

tools.name: get_run_emails
tools.description: The emails the inbox of a test run received (sent to {{inboxEmail}}, <testRunId>@<inbox domain>), newest first: from, subject, when, the text and its links {text, href} — e.g. the confirmation link of a signup to check or to open in a test.

maxTextChars.description: Characters of each email's text to return (default 4000)

annotations.title: Get the emails of a run

tools.name: get_run_logs
tools.description: The browser console (console.* calls, uncaught exceptions, browser messages such as CSP) or the network log (method, URL, status, resource type, duration, size, failure; headers with includeHeaders, credentials redacted) of a test run, in time order. stepIndex is the position of the step that was running (as in get_run), tabNo the tab. Filter by stepRunId (e.g. the failed step from get_failed_step), by level for the console, or failedOnly for requests with status >= 400 or a failed load.

kind.description: console: messages and uncaught errors of the pages; network: their requests

stepRunId.description: Step run id (stepRunId in get_run / get_failed_step): only the entries of that step (UUID)

level.description: Console: only these levels, comma-separated (e.g. "error" or "warn,error")

failedOnly.description: Network: only requests with status >= 400 or a failed load

includeHeaders.description: Network: include request and response headers (default false)

annotations.title: Get the console or network log of a run

instructions:
BugBoom runs end-to-end browser tests (tests → groups → steps) in the cloud.
- The API key (or the BugBoom sign-in of the MCP client) belongs to one organization: the tools see its tests, components, suites and variables. Find things with list_tests, list_suites, list_components, get_test (by id or exact name); ids are UUIDs. get_settings gives the test settings, the test folders and the run profiles. Tests are kept in test folders: list_test_folders, create_test_folder, update_test_folder (rename, move, reorder), delete_test_folder (its tests move up, none is deleted); a test goes into one with folderId of create_test / update_test. Tests carry labels: list_labels, create_label, update_label (rename, recolour), delete_label (taken off its tests, none is deleted); labelIds of create_test / update_test puts them on a test (an update replaces them), list_tests with labelIds finds the tests with any of them.
- Before writing steps read the resource bugboom://docs/steps (types, params, selectors, waiting conditions) and bugboom://docs/steps/{type}.
- Fix loop: run_test → wait_for_run → get_failed_step → query_dom_snapshot (CSS / XPath against the page as it was), get_step_screenshot and get_run_logs (console errors and failed requests of the step) → update_step (params are replaced whole: send every field) → run_test again. The prompt fix-failed-test walks through it.
- A run that ends "error" (not "failed") is an infrastructure problem: run it again instead of editing the test.
- Emails: a test types {{inboxEmail}} (the run's own address) into a form; openInbox opens the run's inbox in a new tab, then click the email by its subject and the link in it. get_run_emails reads what a run received, links included.
- API calls: a request step sends an HTTP request outside the page, checks its status, time and values, and saves values into variables (a token for the next requests, {{token}}); with useBrowserCookies it logs the page in.
- delete_test / delete_step / remove_group cannot be undone: confirm with the user first.
